summary: A 1929 prototype gabled L-4 ground cab in the Kootenai NF, abandoned in 1955, restored in the 1980s, and under volunteer repair since 2024 with 2026 work moved to 2027.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives a camp in 1921 and the prototype cab in 1929; the register and the 2025 newsletter give the same years, with 1921 as the patrol camp.

sources.title: Mountaintop overhaul: Volunteer effort stokes historic fire lookouts back into peak condition

notes_for_editor: Restoration date conflict: register and 2026 summary say restored in the 1980s; firelookout.com says restoration took place through 2000. Both are in the story. Elevation: register 7,606 ft (2,318 m, matches record) vs firelookout.com 7705 ft. The 2024 date for the window removal is inferred from 'started last year' in the 2025 newsletter. Record events 2016 (field assessment), 2018 (new shutters), 2022 (very good shape) and the 2024 pre-project assessment were not found in the pages I read and are left out of this research file; check them before publishing. Access status is not in any source; no access key was set. The 2026 projects page says the project is rescheduled to 2027; any 2026 date in the record should be checked against it. Story no longer calls the site rocky (no source says so) and no longer says a reporter visited (the article gives only the August 10, 2025 date and photo credits).
